title: Genesis 1 Hydraulic Interpretation Evaluation
alternative_explanation: The observed correspondences may arise from metaphorical reading, common human experience with water, literary patterning, or retrospective analogy rather than historical hydraulic design intent.
test_plan: Map each proposed GEI correspondence to the KJV text and its immediate context.
Separate linguistic observations from homophone or symbolic proposals.
Compare proposed functions with independently documented hydraulic technologies.
Search for counterexamples and alternative explanations.
Record results without upgrading hypothesis status merely because relationships exist.
notes: This investigation is designed to permit support, challenge, rejection, or inconclusive findings.
